ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the picture, the Sun is located inside Earth's revolution orbit, and four positions A, B, C, and D are marked on the orbit; C is located at the lower right of the orbit, and beside it there is an arrow of “Earth's revolution direction,” indicating that Earth moves along the orbit; the picture also draws the tilt direction of Earth's axis. Then reason: According to the orbital position where C is located, the revolution direction, and the tilt direction of Earth's axis, when Earth is at position C, the direct solar point is located in the Northern Hemisphere, belonging to the summer half-year of the Northern Hemisphere. Anhui is located in the Northern Hemisphere, and in the summer half-year of the Northern Hemisphere the day arc is longer than the night arc, so Anhui has days longer than nights.

method.method_draft: 根据图中丙所在的轨道位置、公转方向和地轴倾斜方向，判定丙对应北半球太阳直射点位于北半球的时段，即北半球夏半年。再结合安徽位于北半球，夏半年昼弧长于夜弧，所以安徽的昼夜长短状况为昼长夜短。
